mainOwnership: Returned to root after this snapshot; later label/combat integration must rebind final runtime hashes.
scope: Original F4 diplomacy/proposal and territory presentation; simulation unchanged. No claim of full original-game parity.

activation.enabled: EE2 profile with original assets enabled; missing manifest/required controller controls preserves existing UI
activation.mainEdit: One import, awaited enhancement after existing panel construction, diagnostics exposed on window.openepoch. Index unchanged.

limits: Presentation uses original source geometry, sprite crops, color strips and font styles; native cached bitmap glyph rendering is not yet reconstructed, so browser font raster remains an adapter.
Unit tribute is disabled explicitly. Native team/civilization data are unavailable and shown as em dashes; the application has four players while native tables provide nine opponent row holders.

Own peace/alliance/vision and resource/territory commands are retained. Complete native treaty rights, tariffs, durations, unit transfer, taxes and atomic multiresource contracts remain unimplemented.
Source resource matrix stages and submits through existing validated gift controls; source territory/proposal map uses the application map and command validation.

DOM/canvas transport tests exercise production handlers and actual WASM stock changes, not browser CSS raster or Internet/WebRTC connectivity. Source crop previews are composition previews, not original executable captures.
Native hover/modal/tribute sound styles are not fully bound; existing application order sounds and pause behavior remain authoritative.
